app.tagline: Speak. Your words appear wherever you type.

providers.cloud: No API key: sign in and dictate

cloud.price: Free for 3 days, then €8 a month or €49 a year, excluding VAT.
cloud.step1: Sign in with your email address
cloud.checkCode: Check that your browser shows this code
cloud.waiting: Waiting for your approval in the browser…
cloud.denied: This computer wasn't authorized. You can try again.
cloud.expired: The code has expired. Try again to get a new one.
cloud.fairUse: Fair use: up to {day} a day and {month} a month.

status.pastDue: Payment failed. Update your card to keep dictating.
status.none: No active plan. Choose one to start dictating.
status.canceled: Your plan has ended. Choose one to dictate again.
status.unknown: Open your account to see your plan.

trialEnding.continues: Your free trial ends {when}, then your plan takes over. Nothing to do.
trialEnding.stops: Your free trial ends {when} and won't renew. To keep dictating, turn your plan back on.

welcome.title: Your voice, typed anywhere.
welcome.subtitle: Hold a key, speak naturally, let go. Parler types your words in any app: email, chat, documents, code.
welcome.demo: Hi Camille, I'll send you the quote this afternoon. Talk soon!

provider.title: Who turns your voice into text?
provider.subtitle: Parler works with your own account at one of these services. You can switch at any time.
provider.cloudSubtitle: Nothing to set up: sign in once and dictate. You can switch to your own API key at any time.
provider.trialThen: Then €8 a month or €49 a year, excl. VAT.
provider.ownKey: Use my own API key or server

key.title: Connect {provider}
key.subtitle: An API key lets Parler use {provider} for you. It stays on this computer.
key.customSubtitle: Any server that speaks the OpenAI audio API works.
key.step1: Open the {provider} website and sign in
key.step3: Copy it and paste it below

signIn.title: Sign in to Parler Cloud
signIn.subtitle: No key to create: your browser opens, you sign in, and this computer is linked to your account.

permissions.title: Let Parler hear and type
permissions.subtitle: macOS asks once. Parler only listens while you hold the shortcut.
permissions.accessibilityHint: To type the text where your cursor is.

shortcut.title: Your dictation key
shortcut.globe: macOS also reacts to 🌐: set it to “Do Nothing”.
shortcut.access: Parler needs Accessibility access to hear this key.

star.title: Parler is free
star.subtitle: It's open source and costs nothing to use. You only pay your provider, directly, at its own rates.
star.ask: We ask for just one thing: a star on GitHub. It helps other people find Parler and helps the project grow. It means a lot to us.

try.title: Your first dictation
try.holdToSpeak: Click in the box, then hold {keys} and speak.
try.pressToSpeak: Click in the box, then press {keys} and speak.
try.idea1: Remind me to call the bakery tomorrow at nine.
try.idea2: Thanks for your message, I'll get back to you on Monday.
try.idea3: Add milk, eggs and coffee to the shopping list.
try.tip: Speak naturally: punctuation is added for you.

home.subtitle: Parler is ready in all your apps.

hint.smart: Let go to finish. A quick tap keeps listening until the next one.
hint.paste: The text is typed where your cursor is.
hint.copy: The text is copied to your clipboard.

home.emptyHint: Try it now, in any app.

unsent.note: The audio stays on this computer until it's sent, for 7 days at most.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
vocabulary.subtitle: Names, brands and jargon Parler should spell right. They're sent to the service as a hint.
vocabulary.placeholder: Add a word or a name…

problems.unknownProvider: Choose a service in the settings.
problems.missingApiKey: Add your {provider} API key to start dictating.
problems.missingBaseUrl: Enter your server's address in the settings.
problems.unauthorized: {provider} refused the API key. Check it in the settings.
problems.rateLimited: {provider} is limiting requests (rate limit or credit). Try again in a moment.
problems.signedOut: This computer isn't signed in to {provider}. Sign in to keep dictating.
problems.subscriptionRequired: Your {provider} plan isn't active. Choose a plan to keep dictating.
problems.fairUseDay: You've reached today's fair use limit for {provider}. You can dictate again from {time}.
problems.fairUseMonth: You've reached this month's fair use limit for {provider}. You can dictate again from {date}.
problems.microphoneDenied: Parler isn't allowed to use the microphone. Allow it in the privacy settings to dictate.
problems.noSound: Parler got no sound from the microphone: check it isn't muted, and that Parler may use it.
problems.needsAccessibility: Parler needs Accessibility access to type for you. Your text is on the clipboard: paste it with ⌘V.
problems.noClipboard: The clipboard isn't available on this system.
problems.pasteFailed: Pasting failed ({detail}). Your text is on the clipboard.
problems.shortcut: {shortcut} is already used by another app. Pick another shortcut.
problems.singleKey: Parler needs Accessibility access to listen to your shortcut key. Turn it on in System Settings: the key works as soon as it's allowed.

transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.description: The service that turns your voice into text.
transcription.languageHint: Choosing your language makes transcription faster and more accurate.
transcription.modelHint: Pick one, or type any model the service offers.

shortcut.title: Shortcut
shortcut.description: How you start and stop a dictation.
shortcut.label: Dictation shortcut
shortcut.globeHint: macOS also acts on each press of 🌐 (emoji, input source or Dictation). To leave it to Parler, set “Press 🌐 key to” to “Do Nothing” in Keyboard settings.
shortcut.singleKeyHint: Used with another key, like ⌘C or fn ←, it doesn't start a dictation.
shortcut.reserved: {shortcut} is an everyday shortcut (copy, paste, save…). Pick another one.
shortcut.smartHint: Hold to talk, or tap once to start and once more to stop.
shortcut.holdHint: Records for as long as you hold the shortcut.
shortcut.toggleHint: Press to start, press again to stop.
shortcut.wayland: On Wayland, global shortcuts are up to your desktop: bind one to the command {command}.

output.title: Text
output.description: What happens once your words are ready.
output.pasteHint: Typed where your cursor is; your clipboard is put back afterwards.
output.copyHint: Placed on the clipboard for you to paste.

general.title: General
general.soundsHint: A soft cue when listening starts and stops.
general.autostartHint: Parler waits quietly in the menu bar.

about.title: About
about.credits: Free and open source under the MIT licence. Microphone capture and parts of the desktop integration come from Handy.

log.placeholderEmail: What happened? Add your email if you'd like an answer.
log.privacy: Sends Parler's version, your system and its technical log. Never your dictations or keys.
log.failed: Couldn't send it. Check your connection, or attach the file to an email to {email}.
log.tooMany: Several logs were sent this hour already. Try again later.

updates.waiting: Parler {version} will install once this dictation ends.
updates.offline: Couldn't reach the update server. Check your connection and try again.
updates.unsupported: This copy of Parler can't update itself. Download the new version from the website.
updates.signature: The update isn't signed by Parler, so it wasn't installed.
updates.disabled: Updates are handled outside Parler on this system.
